MASTER SUBSCRIPTION TERMS · V4.2
1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 “Authorised User” means an individual whom Customer permits to use the Services, up to the
number stated in the order form;
1.2 “Customer Data” means all data submitted to the Services by or on behalf of Customer;
1.3 “Renewal Term” has the meaning given in clause 14.2;
1.4 “Services” means the hosted software and related support described in the order form;
1.5 “Subscription Fees” means the fees set out in the order form, as adjusted in terms of these
Terms.
2. PROVISION OF THE SERVICES
2.1 Supplier grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right for its Authorised Users to use
the Services for Customer's internal business purposes during the term.
2.2 Supplier may update the Services from time to time, provided that it does not materially reduce
their functionality.
3. CUSTOMER OBLIGATIONS
3.1 Customer is responsible for its Authorised Users' compliance with these Terms, for keeping log-
in details confidential and for the accuracy of Customer Data.
3.2 Customer shall not use the Services to store or transmit unlawful material, or attempt to gain
unauthorised access to the Services.
6. FEES AND PAYMENT
6.1 Subscription Fees are invoiced monthly in advance and are payable by debit order on the first
business day of each month.
6.2 Additional Authorised Users may be added at any time at the then-current per-user rate, pro-
rated for the remainder of the month.
6.3 Overdue amounts bear interest at the prime lending rate of Supplier's bank, and Supplier may
suspend the Services on 14 days' written notice if any amount remains unpaid.
6.4 Supplier may adjust fees on renewal.
6.5 All fees exclude VAT, which Customer shall pay at the applicable rate.

7. SERVICE LEVELS
7.1 Supplier shall use commercially reasonable efforts to make the Services available 99.5% of the
time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least 48 hours in
advance.
7.2 If availability falls below that level, Customer's sole remedy is the service credit set out in
Annexure A.
9. DATA PROTECTION
9.1 In processing personal information contained in Customer Data, Supplier acts as operator for
Customer, as responsible party, within the meaning of the Protection of Personal Information
Act 4 of 2013.
9.2 Customer Data is hosted in data centres in the Republic of South Africa. Supplier shall notify
Customer without undue delay of any security compromise affecting Customer Data.
10. CONFIDENTIALITY
10.1 Each party shall keep the other's confidential information confidential and use it only for the
purposes of these Terms, during the term and for 3 (three) years afterwards.
13. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
13.1 Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, including loss of profit or data.
13.2 Supplier's total liability in any 12-month period shall not exceed the Subscription Fees paid by
Customer in that period.
14. TERM, RENEWAL AND CANCELLATION
14.1 Each subscription starts on the Subscription Start Date and continues for the Initial Term stated
in the order form.
14.2 Thereafter this agreement shall renew automatically for successive periods of 12 (twelve)
months (each a “Renewal Term”), unless cancelled in terms of clause 14.3.
14.3 Either party may cancel this agreement on not less than 60 days' written notice before the re-
newal date.
14.4 Either party may terminate immediately if the other commits a material breach and fails to rem-
edy it within 14 days of written notice.
14.5 For 30 days after termination Customer may export Customer Data in a standard format, after
which Supplier may delete it.

15. SUSPENSION
15.1 Supplier may suspend an Authorised User's access if it reasonably believes the Services are be-
ing used in breach of these Terms, and shall notify Customer promptly.
16. FORCE MAJEURE
16.1 Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, in-
cluding load-shedding or failure of public telecommunications networks, provided it takes reas-
onable steps to mitigate the effect.
17. GENERAL
17.1 These Terms are governed by the law of the Republic of South Africa.
17.2 Any dispute not resolved by negotiation within 20 business days shall be referred to arbitration
under the rules of the Arbitration Foundation of Southern Africa.
17.3 Notices must be in writing and may be given by email to the addresses in the order form.
17.4 These Terms and the order form are the whole agreement. No variation is binding unless recor-
ded in writing and signed by both parties; an electronic signature is sufficient.
17.5 Customer may not cede or assign its rights without Supplier's written consent. Supplier may as-
sign these Terms to an affiliate on written notice.
